title: Topics and tags
description: Topics are categories (each post has one); tags cut across topics. A post refers to them by id in its frontmatter: `topic: electrical`, `tags: [ac-circuits]`. `root` is English, `fr` French, `zh` Simplified Chinese. Series are ordered reading paths (a post joins one with `series: electrical-theory` and an optional `seriesOrder`).

topics.description: Every topic, in the order shown in the topic bar, menus and homepage. Each gets a page at /topics/<id>/, even before it has posts.

summary.description: One sentence, used on the homepage card and as the topic page description.

tags.description: Every tag. A tag gets a page at /tags/<id>/ once a post uses it.

series.description: Every series, in menu order. Each gets a hub at /series/<id>/, even before it has posts (noindex until the first post).

summary.description: One sentence, used on the homepage card and as the topic page description.

id.description: Used in URLs and post frontmatter: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example 3d-printing. Changing it changes the page address.
